findings.title: Dry run can write through symlinks into real project files
findings.description: `copyInstallPaths` preserves symlinks when copying install directories into the sandbox. If an install destination such as `.claude/rules` is a symlink, the installer can follow the copied symlink and write to its real target, despite `--dry-run` promising not to write. Reject symlinked install paths or ensure the sandbox contains independent copies, and add a regression test that verifies the symlink target remains unchanged.

findings.title: A crafted install manifest can delete files outside the checkout
findings.description: The newly used in-process installer reaches `finish()`, which trusts paths in the existing manifest and joins them to `targetRoot` without checking containment. A manifest entry such as `../../outside-file` with a matching CRC and size can cause `fs.rmSync` to delete that file when it is stale. Validate manifest paths and ensure resolved deletion targets remain inside the checkout before reading or deleting them.
